items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: The first record I bought was “In the Mood” because it was Glenn Miller... I couldn’t afford that.

ctx.x: Were records back then a precious commodity? I mean were they precious?

Yeah they were. And they were expensive for a guy like me. The first record I bought was “In the Mood” because it was Glenn Miller which was on whatever it was on, Columbia or RCA, and I couldn’t afford that. I had to buy the English version of it by a band called Joe Walsh, which was a shilling cheaper [scats]. But yeah, I forget how much they cost but if you bought the record you couldn’t take the girl to the movies you know.
You had to have your priorities in order I guess. And they were 78s right?
